details:
I've had two bans within 3 weeks. I do not mind the bans. I have reached out in every way I can. Talking with a lot of other creators it seems even setting the correct content tags keeping it set to private and an 18+ warning at spawn isn't enough. Talking with T&S in appeal didn't get me anywhere and my last message in the ticket was and I quote:

"If at all possible, could you tell me exactly what needs to be removed so I can do it? I'm a bit lost and don't want any more suspensions I fully intend to follow TOS and Community Guidelines."

The ticket was marked solved twice in a row and then replies were turned off. 

What I assume happens is a report occurs and they have some system that scans the world and if it is flagged causes a ban. I've had a private world and a public one banned. If it's as simple as a name change or content tag I am missing would this not be an easy thing to allow creators to know? If it is manual or a video review, can I not be told what was wrong so I can fix it?

I don't understand why they won't give me any information on what is causing it and I feel pretty strangled by it when I know much worse worlds only locked with codes are out there. I want to continue creating here and I want to follow the rules.

I understand the limitations of the team and age gating but even when creators do follow the correct steps we still tank bans. I also know of creators who don't tank bans when they also illicit "Sensitive, intimate, or provocative content, or extreme horror or “shock” content" in public worlds with signs linking to Patreon's. I linked that specifically from creator guidelines as I assume that is what will be the case for me.

I don't even feel like I've spoken to a human yet. If my worlds were reviewed manually, what did I do wrong? If there isn't time for that, could you not look at the build log when a world is uploaded and tell me what flagged? I rigorously scan my public worlds long before I ever publish them. My private ones are content tagged, age gated and whitelisted through VRC 18+ system itself with rules and consent signs at spawn. 

The rules in Community Guidelines being thrown around so vaguely feels extremely unfair. 

My feature request is that I want a clear answer on what is allowed and isn't. Or a direct line to T&S outside of the appeal system. Maybe a new request tab titled "Guideline Discussion" or "Ask a question" where I can directly ask someone for a manual review or greenlight even if responses take a few days or weeks. Would be better than nothing. 

Thank you for reading.
title: New option in VRChat Help Desk for manual reveiws.
